units.i2v_prompt: Single continuous take at 24fps, 9:16 vertical. A faint handheld drift keeps the frame alive. **Heavy night rain streaks down continuously and fast across the whole frame**, drops bursting on the railing and the shoulders; the rain-soaked coat flaps and lifts in the wind in steady ripples; the steel watch chain swings and catches the backlight. The figure stays facing away, only the shoulders moving with the wind. Strong continuous environmental motion. No text, no logos.
